description: **BREAKING CHANGE**: The `Metadata` field on `types.Application` has been changed from `map[string]string` to `map[string]*string`. The service returns explicit `null` values in this map (e.g. `WORKING_DIRECTORY`), which were not modeled as sparse. Previously the `null` entries were silently dropped, and with CBOR deserialization they caused a deserialization error.
